scope: Source/schema review only. No partial actual prediction records, images, arrays, weights or live account were opened to construct this plan.

require_before_any_complete_scientific_c: guardian/stop-record.json status complete, Job active processes 0, lock released, cleanup errors empty, worker and launcher exits 0
budget model_load_roles and released_model_roles exactly frozen, adapted; active_models 0; source_logical_steps 500
budget completed_updates, spent_reserved_updates and spent_train_examples all 0; selection_count 0; checkpoint null
new measurement row identity grid complete and duplicate-free; invalid measurements retained
closed_run_gate.if_stopped: Report partial persisted/reserved/completed counts separately, no padding or reuse of the old 333 reservations, no full gate conclusions. Durable file counts are not exact runtime call counts.

rules: Derive shape/contact-specific denominators from declared physical cases, retaining regression and independent strata separately.
Three noise seeds are nested repeats of one physical branch, not three independent physical samples.
Keep the pre-existing unavailable physical candidate separate from newly missing predictions or measurement abstention; do not reconstruct its data.
H3 remains in AR history and sequence eligibility even when primary display tables show H1/H2/H4.
TF H1 is not an independent call or row.

summaries: all finite and exact matching index/noise identities
loss_and_accounting.limitation: Loss is the fixed independent-validation diagnostic; improvement alone does not establish dynamics, stopping or policy benefit.

shape_pusher_pose_coverage.display: Separate AR H1/H2/H4 and TF H2/H4, with H3 retained as sequence context. Show valid n / planned n and error count, P90 and maximum together.
rules: object_shape is joint valid object pose and shape, not a pure visual shape-class accuracy.
Pusher validity is local and independent of the object flag. Coverage requires valid object/shape plus a valid coverage estimate.
Conditional errors must never be described as all-row errors. Unknown and abstention are not zero error.
Do not average cell P90 values into a pooled P90; either retain contact cells or use closed numeric rows for a clearly labelled pooled calculation.
Shape screen is joint validity >=90%, pusher screen >=95%; limited measurable-row P90 bounds are position/angle/pusher 5 pixels/degrees and coverage .05.
Decoder rejection is not itself proof of a physical dynamics error.
T overall combines AR relative retention, absolute AR H1/H2/H4 and paired ranking. Relative AR also includes H3. TF is a separate conditioning diagnostic and cannot rescue AR.
Validity uses the entire declared denominator; any new invalid row remains visible even if other rows gain validity.
Compare errors only on the exact matched common-valid subset, while showing its coverage and all-anchor support.
Paired-error-increase P90 differs from difference-of-P90; retain the distinct labels.
Insufficient support is passed null, never an implicit pass.
These dynamics summaries use AR H4 only; TF remains in the separate measurement table.
Contact comparison needs at least 8 physical branches and all relevant contact rows measurable; compare persistence on the same measurable subset.
Rotation support needs at least 4 physical branches and 2 anchors. Direction fraction includes abstentions in its denominator; angle-error statistics are conditional.

Independent B2 has only 4 contact branches and 2 rotation branches per shape. Three noise seeds and the older regression cases cannot increase that independent physical support; support-limited decisions stay null.
Rotation screen uses its predeclared mean-angle/persistence/direction conditions, distinct from the general measurable-row P90 screen.
Ranking scores come only from complete AR H1-H4 stopping-consistent sequences, all 3 seeds per candidate and all 4 candidates. A valid raw H4 endpoint cannot rescue earlier unknown history.
The paired ranking identity/completeness check includes the full planned AR/TF grid; TF does not supply ranking scores.
Informative anchors/pairs are defined only by declared physical H4 coverage gaps >=.05, never by predictions or validity.
Complete uninformative anchors remain in the full counts and state retention, neutral rather than ranking successes or failures.
Show common anchor IDs and comparable-pair denominators; zero comparable pairs gives accuracy null.
Per-role accuracy_including_abstentions is conservative, not observed-only pair accuracy. Keep tied and abstained pair counts separate.

Join hold_regret and uniform_expected_regret from per-role anchor records only on the same common anchor subset when comparing against selected regret. Any full-physical baseline is a separately labelled denominator.
Sparse H4 informative anchors do not establish policy improvement or generalization.

termination.source: screens.json dynamics; closed measurement JSON only if more descriptive counts are needed
rules: Success uses the existing strict coverage threshold >.95 and the unchanged development +/- .03 interval assumption.
No predicted successes gives precision null. Unknowns remain unknown, not true negatives or automatic errors.
The current aggregate does not provide full TP/TN/FP/FN counts; never invent them from precision alone.
Near-threshold descriptive strata or missing positive support cannot certify termination. No new outcome-selected threshold or interval calibration is allowed.
independent_termination_precision_validated and paired_retention.termination_certified remain false regardless of apparent precision.

paired_record_identity_audit_after_close.source: new measurements/*.json only, no RGB/NPY load or resampling

exact_cross_weight_matches.input_sha256: AR H1 and TF H2/H4 only: 999 paired keys from identical real histories

intentional_nonrequirements: AR H2-H4 input hashes may differ across weights because prior raw predictions feed back; this is intended.
AR and TF input hashes may differ at H2/H4; their horizon RNG and actions should still match.
Raw prediction hashes are identities, not required equal across different weights and not evidence of accuracy.
paired_record_identity_audit_after_close.important_schema_limit: Current paired_retention pair_quality checks RNG/truth/contact, not action/input hashes. Report action/input checks separately from saved numeric records after explicit post-exit authorization.
paired_record_identity_audit_after_close.feedback_source_evidence: gpc_adaptation.rollout_case applies T1 only to real conditioning frames, feeds back raw AR predictions without clipping or reapplying T1, and uses clipped RGB only for the rgb_mae diagnostic.
